verdict.rationale: Bevy is dual-licensed MIT/Apache 2.0 with explicit 'no contracts, no license fees, no sales cuts, 100% free forever' messaging, and permissive OSS licenses cannot be retroactively revoked for code already shipped under them, structurally guaranteeing stability for shipped games. Community sentiment (bevy-comm-2) independently praises the MIT license as having 'no strings attached.' Missing for 10: an explicit multi-year track record narrative or historical example of license terms being tested/changed and holding stable.
